_comment: Shared cross-language fixture for manual-workout budget counting.
Derived from a real divergence on 2026-08-27: the phone showed
'Manual: 2/2w 4/10m -- budget exhausted' while the PC read 1/2w 2/10m.
Two Dart-only defects caused it, both represented below:
1. the phone's merge ignored tombstones, so the deleted duplicate
manual:2026-08-21T21:00 still consumed a weekly slot;
2. the phone counted the evidence-less stub manual_workout:2026-08-15,
which the PC refuses to ingest, costing an extra monthly slot.
Each side's own round-trip test passed while the pair disagreed, so this
literal -- read by both -- is the only thing that catches the drift.
Future-dated (planned) manual entries, added 2026-10-16. Readers of the
top-level today/records/expected above ignore this key, so those
expectations are unchanged.
Scenario: the top-level records PLUS extra_records, still as of 'today'.
A manual workout may be dated up to 7 days ahead; the PC credits it on
its own date. Budget for adding an entry dated D = the fullest 7-/30-day
window CONTAINING D, counting past and future live entries (stubs and
tombstones excluded, as above). expected_by_date maps D to that budget.
The deleted 08-30 plan proves a cancelled plan frees its slot: live, it
would put 08-28 and 08-30 in one 7-day window (2/2, exhausted).
